title: Due to a missing authorization check in certain remote-enabled functionality, SAP Solution Tools Plug-In allows an…
description: CVE-2026-109808 is a vulnerability in the SAP Solution Tools Plug-In caused by a missing authorization check in certain remote-enabled functionality. An authenticated attacker with prior knowledge of specific internal identifiers can exploit this flaw to access data that should be restricted. The impact is limited to confidentiality with no effect on integrity or availability. The overall severity is low.
